in_hebrew.name: חנון
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hebrew root 'חנן' (chinan), meaning 'gracious, merciful, benevolent, compassionate, or pitiful.' It is a name given to those who show kindness and compassion towards others.

in_greek.name: Ενώσων
in_greek.long_meaning: A name derived from the Greek root 'ενήσω' (heneso), meaning 'to join, to unite, to assemble, or to bring together.' It is a name given to those who bring people or things together.

in_latin.name: Hensonius
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latin name derived from the Old English word 'hen' meaning 'hen' and the suffix '-son' meaning 'son.' It is a name given to someone whose father or ancestor was associated with hens.
